description: Complete 88-file official DeepSeek V4.1 Flash snapshot at dba1be0a: 48 mixed FP4/FP8/BF16 shards, vision tower, native DSpark prediction layers, tokenizer, prompt encoder and minimal inference reference. Serves as the source of the Engram n-gram tables (shards 47 and 48) for the MiaAI-Lab EXL3 checkpoint.
